subject: E-Commerce
title: Fake Reviews: A Billion-Dollar Industry
description: A quick win: understand Fake Reviews: A Billion-Dollar Industry.

hook.text: An estimated 40% of online reviews are fake. Companies pay $5-$10 per fake five-star review on Amazon.

buildup.text: Fake review farms operate in Bangladesh, Pakistan, and China. Sellers buy hundreds of reviews in bulk.

discovery.text: Amazon deletes millions of fake reviews yearly. But new ones replace them faster than they're removed.

twist.text: Tools like Fakespot and ReviewMeta analyze review patterns to detect fakes. Adjusted ratings often drop 1+ stars.

climax.text: The fake review economy undermines trust in the entire review system. It's an arms race with no end.

punchline.text: 40% fake, $5 per review. The trust system runs on manufactured trust.

quiz.question: What tools can help detect fake online reviews?
options: Fakespot and ReviewMeta that analyze review patterns
